corrected_code:
@router.post('/api/documents/{doc_id}/transfer-ownership')
async def transfer_document_ownership(
    doc_id: int,
    body: TransferOwnershipSchema,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    stmt = select(Document).where(Document.id == doc_id, Document.owner_id == user.id)
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    doc = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not doc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Document not found")
        
    doc.owner_id = body.target_user_id
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": "ownership transferred", "new_owner": body.target_user_id}
